title: Managing the Collections and Credit Control Team
overview: The structure, management, and positioning of a collections and credit control department significantly influence its impact on an organization, potentially transforming it into a key driver of profitability. This course delves into the best practices for structuring the collections department, focusing on management techniques, key performance indicators, and process optimization. The result is improved management information, streamlined operations, and enhanced collector efficiency.
audience: This course is designed for professionals looking to establish or optimize a credit function, as well as those currently managing a credit function with the goal of improving profitability and operational efficiency. It is also suitable for team leaders and managers in collections, credit control, client accounts, finance, and accounting, across any industry. Banking or risk management professionals overseeing collections and credit control performance will also benefit.
methodology: The course is built around real-world case studies, diagnostic tools, interactive exercises, and practical resources that participants can apply in their own organizations. It also provides an opportunity for participants to discuss specific challenges with an industry expert.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Reposition the credit function to contribute to organizational profitability
Develop and manage a high-performance collections or credit control department
Identify the ideal role for each team member to maximize departmental efficiency
Enhance the internal image of the collections department and its importance within the business
Lead a credit control team that adapts effectively to change
